fields.statement: At 9e405b92b, go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'Review|Plan' -v passed all 13 tests, including the new TestReviewSeverityBlockShared, which extracts each topic's '## Severities' section and asserts review.md and plan-review.md match byte for byte, that both Critic sections contain confirmed, downgraded, dropped and 'Never add a finding', and that the block contains none of 'go ', 'make ', 'rhiza check/render/ship' or 'testscript'. Reading the diff: the shared block lists blocker (behaviour broken, build or test fails, leaf missing), major (acceptance point unmet, real defect), minor (style, naming, docs, non-blocking follow-up) and nit, with a mapping per check and for plan review; both critic sections say confirm, downgrade or drop and never add a finding or raise a severity. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... also passed. Side changes: TopicCap rose from 800 to 1000, and review.md's opener no longer says review verifiers get RHIZA_LEAF, although internal/run/checks.go still starts review verifiers. That is a minor docs loss and does not affect acceptance.
